log.text: Gholdengo used Make It Rain → Krookodile

decisions.rationale: Sun mode is our strongest win condition into rain. Charizard-Y Mega Evolves to override Drizzle, Venusaur outspeeds everything under Chlorophyll. Krookodile provides Intimidate and Ground coverage for Archaludon/Gholdengo. Hydreigon's Levitate avoids EQ, Dark Pulse threatens Gholdengo, Fire Blast hits Archaludon. Both leads are special so Gyarados Intimidate is blanked. Sableye sits out: Good as Gold blocks Prankster Taunt, and it's too slow to Fake Out Grimmsnarl first.
decisions.notebook: G2 opponent full roster: Pelipper(DampRock/Drizzle), Swampert-Mega(SwiftSwim), Archaludon(LifeOrb/Stamina), Gholdengo(GoodAsGold/Sitrus), Gyarados(Intimidate/Leftovers/DDance), Grimmsnarl(Prankster/LightClay/screens/FakeOut/SpiritBreak). G1 tendencies: Pelipper Wide Guards spread moves, Tailwinds early. Gholdengo double Protects. Good as Gold blocks all Prankster status — use attacks not status vs Gholdengo. Archaludon Electro Shot charges even outside rain. Sun mode (Zard-Y + Venu) wins weather war. Preserve Charizard to maintain sun; eliminate Pelipper first. Krookodile Intimidate helps vs physical threats. Hydreigon Levitate immune to ally EQ and foe Ground.

decisions.rationale: Intended Mega: Swampert. Lead Peli+Pert sets rain and immediately threatens Venu with Ice Punch while WideGuard/Tailwind covers HeatWave/RockSlide; back Ghold blocks Sableye status and Arch ElectroShots CharY/Hydreigon. Full mode beats sun by re-setting rain and removing CharY fast.
decisions.notebook: Matchup: Rain does not hard-win vs Mega CharY+Chlorophyll Venu (Drought overrides). Opp G1 brought CharY/Venu/Krook/Sableye (held Sinistcha/Hydreigon). CharY Timid Drought (HeatWave/SolarBeam/Protect/WeatherBall). Sableye MentalHerb Prankster (FakeOut/WoW/Taunt/FoulPlay). Venu LO Chlorophyll Timid (GigaDrain/SludgeBomb/SleepPowder/Protect). Krook FocusSash Intimidate Jolly (EQ/KnockOff/RockSlide/Protect). Ghold GaG blocks status. DampRock Peli mandatory but insufficient alone. Prefer remove CharY pre-mega; respect Prankster+Intim. Sinistcha Hospitality+RagePowder still out. G2 plan: MegaPert+Peli+Ghold+Arch; re-set rain after Drought; ElectroShot CharY; IcePunch Venu; GaG vs Sableye.

decisions.rationale: Mega Zard-Y sets sun: Solar Beam instant OHKO on Swampert, Venusaur Chlorophyll → 290 Speed. Sleep Powder on Pelipper (75%) blocks Tailwind/Wide Guard/Hurricane before foes move. If it misses, Hurricane 65-117% on Venusaur is the cost, but Swampert dies before Ice Punch. Sun stays; Zard-Y wins weather war. Swampert Protect only wastes one Solar Beam; asleep Pelipper buys free next turn.
decisions.notebook: G2 opponent leads standard rain: Pelipper(DampRock/Drizzle) + Swampert(Mega/SwiftSwim). Pelipper Wide Guards spread moves, Tailwinds early per G1. Zard-Y sun mode counters rain: Solar Beam oneshots Swampert-Mega, Chlorophyll Venu outspeeds everything. Eliminate Pelipper to lock sun. Backline: Archaludon(ElectroShot/LO), Gholdengo(Gold), Gyarados(Intim/DDance), Grimmsnarl(screens/FakeOut). Good as Gold blocks Prankster — attack Gholdengo, never status it.

decisions.rationale: Force damage before Drought: Water WB 2x Char (may not KO), IcePunch 2x Venu. Mega now for SS after rain reset. EQ hits ally; Liq weak into Venu. Tailwind slower payoff T1.
Gholdengo Good as Gold blocks Sleep Powder/status; resists Grass from Venu; Make It Rain pressures both. Arch weaker into Venu Grass and can be statused. Need rain reset later via Peli.

G2 T1: Venu SleepPowder Peli, CharY SolarBeam KO MegaPert in sun.

decisions.rationale: Venusaur (290 Spe) Giga Drains Pelipper first (38-90%), then Charizard (167 Spe) Weather Balls Gholdengo for guaranteed OHKO (119-263%) before Gholdengo can move. Charizard takes zero damage this turn regardless of Gholdengo's action. If Gholdengo Protects, Pelipper is still heavily chipped and asleep. Perfect tempo: eliminate the only active threat while pressuring the sleeper.

selection: Wide Guard (your side, including ally Gholdengo)
decisions.rationale: Pelipper asleep; Wide Guard blocks Heat Wave. Ghold Protects vs any single-target or second spread. Denies free KO while sleep resolves; Arch in back for ElectroShot after.

decisions.rationale: Venusaur 290 Speed outspeeds all; Giga Drain guaranteed KO on Pelipper at 40% before it acts, locking permanent sun. Charizard Heat Wave punishes Gholdengo for 92-167% (possible OHKO). Even if Pelipper wakes and Wide Guards (+3 priority), Giga Drain still KOs; Heat Wave blocked is acceptable. Gholdengo Thunderbolt cannot OHKO Charizard (51-73%).
decisions.notebook: G2: Pelipper(DampRock/Drizzle) removed; permanent sun locked. Opp backline: Archaludon(ElectroShot/LO/Modest), Gholdengo(Sitrus), Gyarados(Intim/DDance), Grimmsnarl(screens/FakeOut/Prankster). Good as Gold blocks Prankster status. Key threat: Gholdengo Thunderbolt 2HKOs Zard-Y. Archaludon ElectroShot threatens in rain but sun blocks charge skip. Gyarados Intimidate weakens physical attackers on switch.

decisions.rationale: Peli asleep may not act; Wide Guard covers Heat Wave. Ghold Tbolts CharY (2x Electric) for chip/KO pressure before sun ends. Avoid Protect fail and MIR NVE. Arch later for ElectroShot.

decisions.rationale: Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Zard-Y at 33% dies to Gholdengo Thunderbolt before moving. Krookodile is Electric-immune, outspeeds both foes, and threatens SE Earthquake. Venusaur Sleep Powders Archaludon (only valid target; Gholdengo immune). 75% hit disables Archaludon for a 2v1; even on miss, Venusaur likely survives one hit at 90%. Next turn Krookodile EQ sweeps.
decisions.notebook: G2: Sun permanent. Opp backline Archaludon(LO/Modest/Stamina), Gholdengo(Sitrus/Timid/GoodAsGold). Gholdengo blocks status. Archaludon ElectroShot threatens in rain; sun blocks charge skip. Krookodile EQ hits both SE, Focus Sash intact. Hydreigon fast special attacker.

decisions.rationale: Sun: Electro Shot charges (no rain). Ghold Tbolt KOs 32% para CharY. GaG blocks powder on Ghold. Arch Protects vs Venu Sleep Powder and any Heat Wave chip. Sludge immune; Giga resisted.

decisions.rationale: Protect shields Venusaur from both EQ and Make It Rain. EQ spreads 40–69% on Archaludon and 51–91% on Gholdengo. Krookodile's Sash holds against Make It Rain alone, and Archaludon must choose between hitting a Protected Venusaur or a Sash Krookodile. Next turn Sun ends but both foes are chipped and Venusaur stays healthy at 90%.

selection: Protect [success rate reduced: Protected last turn]
decisions.rationale: Sun ends this turn; Venu outspeeds and can Sleep Arch (GaG blocks Ghold). Arch Protect (even reduced) dodges Sleep/EQ while Ghold MIR pressures both—Krook Sash + Venu chip. Stamina may proc on EQ if Protect fails. Avoid free SE EQ into both.

decisions.rationale: Krookodile 158 outspeeds both foes; EQ guaranteed KOs Gholdengo (51-91% into 45%) and likely KOs Archaludon (40-69% into 43%). Switching Venusaur to Hydreigon avoids EQ damage via Levitate and brings a fresh 100% threat. Even if Gholdengo Protects, it saves itself but Archaludon still likely falls, leaving 3v1 with Hydreigon outspeeding the survivor. Venusaur had no good attacks into Steel-types anyway.

Both foes Protect-used: Arch 33% next, Gholdengo reset. Krook EQ guarantees KO on Gholdengo at 45% and likely KOs Archaludon at 43%. Hydreigon 165 Speed outspeeds all foes.

decisions.rationale: Krook outspeeds Arch and EQ KOs Ghold range; Protect Arch lets Stamina hold while MIR finishes 3% Krook (or chips Venu if Protect). Double Protect fails. FC+Protect leaves Krook free.

Krookodile EQ is guaranteed KO from 43% (54-92%) and Hydreigon outspeeds. Levitate makes Hydreigon immune to EQ. Draco Meteor also guaranteed KO (56-109%). Both outspeed Archaludon (105-137). Even if Archaludon Protects successfully, it's 2v1 next turn with Protect further degraded. No losing line exists.
decisions.notebook: Series won 2-0. Opponent rain team: Pelipper (DampRock/Tailwind), Mega Swampert (Swift Swim), Archaludon (LO/Stamina/ElectroShot), Gholdengo (Sitrus/GoodAsGold). Backups: Gyarados (Intimidate/DDance), Grimmsnarl (Prankster screens). Key: deny rain, exploit Electro Shot charge turns, Archaludon's Stamina punishes spread moves.

decisions.rationale: Krook at 3% dies to residual/chip or any neutral hit next; must pressure full HP Hydreigon now. Draco is 2x STAB LO into it. Electro charges outside rain and is resisted/immune. Protect odds down after consecutive use. Single mon left.

reflections.summary: We won by denying rain offense. Venusaur's Sleep Powder shut down Pelipper early, allowing a quick KO. Mega Charizard Y's sun overwrote their weather, powering up Venusaur's Chlorophyll. Krookodile's Earthquake bypassed Gholdengo's Wide Guard, heavily damaging both remaining opponents. Archaludon's attempted double Protect failed, costing them momentum, and Hydreigon cleaned up with Draco Meteor. The opponent's reliance on rain left them helpless once Pelipper fell and sun took over.
reflections.adjustment: If the opponent adjusts by bringing Grimmsnarl for screens next game, we should consider a screen breaker (e.g., Brick Break, Psychic Fangs) or Taunt to prevent setup. Alternatively, lead with Krookodile + Hydreigon to apply immediate offensive pressure with Intimidate and special attacks, preserving Charizard to reset weather later, so we aren't crippled by a double screen opener.
reflections.notebook: Series won 2-0. Updated opponent tendencies: Game 2 they led Pelipper + Gholdengo, with Swampert and Archaludon in back. Pelipper was slept early then KO'd; Gholdengo's Wide Guard blocked our Heat Wave but fell to repeated Earthquakes. Archaludon double Protected (failed), indicating they may be overly protective of it. Gholdengo's Make It Rain crit, but Krookodile's Focus Sash saved. Opponent may pivot to Grimmsnarl for screens to bolster bulk; if so, expect Reflect/LightScreen and a more passive lead. Their rain plan crumbles without Pelipper, so continue to prioritize removing it quickly or denying rain. Archaludon's Electro Shot is useless without rain, and Stamina can be overwhelmed by special attacks before it accumulates boosts. Our sun core (Charizard-Y, Venusaur) remains effective, but beware paralysis on Charizard from Electric moves like Thunderbolt.

reflections.summary: Lost because preview locked Mega Swampert+Pelipper rain into the known Drought CharY+Chlorophyll Venu core that overrides drizzle, leaving Swift Swim offline, Pelipper deleted early, and Arch/Ghold unable to stabilize vs follow-up Krook EQ + Hydreigon.
reflections.adjustment: Change preview: drop MegaPert/rain entirely vs this sun core; bring a non-weather mega or anti-sun four that pressures CharY on sight without needing drizzle reset.
